name: outlook-{DAY}
title: Catalyst outlook {DAY}
subtitle: Every US $2B+ name with its catalysts over the next six weeks (earnings with slot, ex-dividend, IPO lockups, dated OUTSIDE events) and the day's suites side by side. Columns run in one order on every table: technical, setup, earnings surprise, value, progression, lists. Each table is one order; nothing is a sum.

blocks.title: Top 20 plays, this week and next (judgment, reading order)
Shortlist: earnings and catalysts, today to next week (judgment)
Positioning for the next 4-5 weeks (judgment)
Other catalysts that move the Book or the shortlist (judgment, OUTSIDE)
Tonight's calls (judgment)

blocks.text: One row per name whose print reaction lands on the session in `PACK/print_night` (default the next one: tonight's AMC and tomorrow's BMO). Counts are measured pointers up / down per horizon (rx reaction, h7 / h28 hold from the close before the print); the lists name them; the set-up cell gives the overnight tail. Start with a screen; the Guide tab has the steps. On demand: `tv_scan_cli.py print-night --pack PACK --line` (`--react-on YYYY-MM-DD`, `--sessions 5` for the week).

blocks.title: Decision matrix: every reporter of the session, pointers up / down per horizon, the overnight tail and the levels

source.sql: SELECT symbol, phase, slot, mcap_b, close, day, runup, react_abs_mean, react_up, rx_up, rx_dn, h7_up, h7_dn, h28_up, h28_dn, h28_fam_up, h28_fam_dn, h28_up_list, h28_dn_list, h7_up_list, h7_dn_list, rx_up_list, rx_dn_list, setup_cell, setup_mean, setup_rx_mean, setup_rx_q10, setup_rx_q90, tail_starter_usd, up_starter_usd, own_move_starter_usd, peer_rx, peer_n, dec_7d, dec_7d_fx, state_7d, pt_up, pe_nfy_vs_ind, pe_nfy_vs_own, eps_rev_3m, last_surprise, bounce_low, bounce_high, bounce_kill, entry_low, entry_high, kill_px, book_usd, in_store FROM names ORDER BY book_usd DESC NULLS LAST, h28_up - h28_dn DESC, mcap_b DESC

screens.label: Hold 28d leans up
screens.explain: 3+ pointers up on the 28-day hold, at most 1 down, from 2+ families. A pre-print entry held through has had the wind behind it; still check the tail (tail_starter_usd) and the down list before entering.

screens.label: 7d leans up
screens.explain: 2+ pointers up on the 7-day hold and none down: the short event trade. Enter as a limit, kill on a close, size from the event budget.

screens.label: Both horizons up
screens.explain: Up on both hold horizons with nothing (7d) or one (28d) against: the strongest pre-print lean the counts can show.

screens.label: Leans down
screens.explain: 4+ pointers down on the 28-day hold, at most 1 up: wait for the print (buy the reaction in the bounce band if it holds) or DERISK a held line into it.

screens.label: Reaction arrows
screens.explain: Any pointer up on the reaction session itself and none down. Few cells call the reaction before a print; treat this as a tilt, not a call.

screens.label: Book lines printing
screens.explain: Held lines in the session: read the down list and tail_starter_usd (and rx_tail_usd on Week plays) to decide hold vs DERISK into the print.

screens.label: Quiet past prints
screens.explain: The name's own past prints moved less than 4% on average either way (react_abs_mean; own_move_starter_usd in dollars of a $5,000 starter). The set-up cell's tail (tail_starter_usd) is the same for every name in one cell, so this is the name-level size read.

blocks.title: Session base: what every past print did (each pointer's lift is measured against the rest of these prints)

source.sql: SELECT phase, measure, label, n, mean, median, hit, q10, q90 FROM base ORDER BY phase DESC, measure

blocks.text: Each column is one pointer: the lift (pp) of the quintile the name sits in against every other past print. ▲ / ▼ = the direction is clear (t, n, both halves, hit rate); a bare number = measured, not clear; empty = no value. Families are the group headers: arrows from several families are more independent evidence than three from Tape.

blocks.title: Hold 28 days from the close before the print: lift per pointer (pp)

source.sql: SELECT m.symbol, n.slot, n.mcap_b, m.ptr_up, m.ptr_dn, m.fam_up, m.fam_dn, m.x_runup, m.x_r_1m, m.x_r_3m, m.x_rsi, m.x_vs50, m.x_hi_prox, m.x_rvol_20, m.x_beta, m.x_prev_react, m.x_last_surprise, m.x_slot, m.x_eps_rev_3m, m.x_eps_rev_1m, m.x_rev_rev_3m, m.x_eps_q_step, m.x_rev_q_step, m.x_pt_up, m.x_pt_rev_1m, m.x_ey_fwd, m.x_fcf_margin, m.x_p_dvc, m.x_p_cons_w, m.x_peer_rx, n.book_usd FROM matrix m JOIN names n USING (symbol) WHERE m.side = 'pre' AND m.measure = 'hold_fx_28d' ORDER BY m.ptr_up - m.ptr_dn DESC, n.mcap_b DESC

screens.label: 3+ up, 1 or less down
screens.explain: Names where at least three pointers point up on the 28-day hold and at most one down; read the families across the row.

blocks.title: Hold 7 days from the close before the print: lift per pointer (pp)

source.sql: SELECT m.symbol, n.slot, n.mcap_b, m.ptr_up, m.ptr_dn, m.fam_up, m.fam_dn, m.x_runup, m.x_r_1m, m.x_r_3m, m.x_rsi, m.x_vs50, m.x_hi_prox, m.x_rvol_20, m.x_beta, m.x_prev_react, m.x_last_surprise, m.x_slot, m.x_eps_rev_3m, m.x_eps_rev_1m, m.x_rev_rev_3m, m.x_eps_q_step, m.x_rev_q_step, m.x_pt_up, m.x_pt_rev_1m, m.x_ey_fwd, m.x_fcf_margin, m.x_p_dvc, m.x_p_cons_w, m.x_peer_rx, n.book_usd FROM matrix m JOIN names n USING (symbol) WHERE m.side = 'pre' AND m.measure = 'hold_fx_7d' ORDER BY m.ptr_up - m.ptr_dn DESC, n.mcap_b DESC

screens.label: 2+ up, none down
screens.explain: At least two pointers up on the 7-day hold and none down.

blocks.title: Reaction session vs the market: lift per pointer (pp)

source.sql: SELECT m.symbol, n.slot, n.mcap_b, m.ptr_up, m.ptr_dn, m.fam_up, m.fam_dn, m.x_runup, m.x_r_1m, m.x_r_3m, m.x_rsi, m.x_vs50, m.x_hi_prox, m.x_rvol_20, m.x_beta, m.x_prev_react, m.x_last_surprise, m.x_slot, m.x_eps_rev_3m, m.x_eps_rev_1m, m.x_rev_rev_3m, m.x_eps_q_step, m.x_rev_q_step, m.x_pt_up, m.x_pt_rev_1m, m.x_ey_fwd, m.x_fcf_margin, m.x_p_dvc, m.x_p_cons_w, m.x_peer_rx, n.book_usd FROM matrix m JOIN names n USING (symbol) WHERE m.side = 'pre' AND m.measure = 'react_fx' ORDER BY m.ptr_up - m.ptr_dn DESC, n.mcap_b DESC

screens.label: Any arrow
screens.explain: Names with a reaction arrow up. Few cells call the reaction before the print: read it beside the hold tables, not alone.

blocks.text: After the print. Rows appear once the print is in the day file: the post-close all-fields scan, then `run_daily_refresh.py --update-day D --no-producers` (or `tv_scan_cli.py print-night --pack PACK --react-on today` the next morning). The print's own pointers (surprise, mix, after-hours read, reaction) are measured on the reaction (rx), the reaction close minus the after-hours read (ac) and the 28-day drift (d28). Decide held lines at the cash close.

blocks.title: Printed: the print's pointers and the week-plays post cells

source.sql: SELECT symbol, slot, rev_posted, close, day, post_chg, react_fx, last_surprise, rev_surprise, surprise_mix, rx_up, rx_dn, ac_up, ac_dn, d28_up, d28_dn, rx_up_list, rx_dn_list, d28_up_list, d28_dn_list, mix_cell, mix_mean, setrx_cell, setrx_mean, setrx_t, ah_q_cell, ah_q_mean, ah_q_q10, ah_q_q90, bounce_low, bounce_high, bounce_kill, book_usd FROM names WHERE phase = 'post' ORDER BY book_usd DESC NULLS LAST, react_fx

screens.label: Drift leans up
screens.explain: A print pointer points up on the 28-day drift and none down: a candidate to hold or add on a dip, in the bounce band.

screens.label: Sold, drift not down
screens.explain: Sold 5%+ vs the market with no drift pointer down: the recovery candidates (earnings playbook: full bounce band, wait for a close inside it on a CONTINUE_DOWN tape).

screens.label: After-hours tends to close better
screens.explain: AMC rows whose after-hours read sits in a cell where the reaction close beat the after-hours print: do not act on the after-hours number.

blocks.title: Printed: lift per print pointer (pp), by measure

source.sql: SELECT m.symbol, m.measure, m.ptr_up, m.ptr_dn, m.x_eps_surprise, m.x_rev_surprise, m.x_surprise_mix, m.x_ah_read, m.x_react_fx FROM matrix m WHERE m.side = 'post' ORDER BY m.symbol, m.measure

blocks.text: The backtest behind every arrow: each pointer's quintiles (categories for slot and mix) on the lab's past prints, what they did next and how far from the rest. Check n, both halves and hit_lift before trusting a cell; many cells are tested, so a few arrows are chance. Prefer arrows in the end quintiles (Q1 / Q5) that agree across families.

blocks.title: Every measured pointer cell

source.sql: SELECT pointer, family, bucket, measure, n, mean, hit, q10, q90, lift, lift_t, half1_lift, half2_lift, hit_lift, dir, label FROM cells ORDER BY measure, pointer, bucket

screens.label: Arrows only
screens.explain: The cells that set an arrow; sort by lift_t or lift to see the strongest.

screens.label: Hold 28d arrows
screens.explain: What the 28-day hold-through rewarded and punished before the print.

screens.label: Reaction arrows
screens.explain: What called the reaction session itself (before the print: few cells; after it: the surprise, the mix and the after-hours read).

blocks.title: Per name: every arrow behind the counts (value, bucket, the cell's evidence)

source.sql: SELECT symbol, side, measure, pointer, family, value, bucket, n, mean, hit, lift, lift_t, half1_lift, half2_lift, hit_lift, dir FROM pointers WHERE dir IN ('up', 'down') ORDER BY symbol, measure, dir, pointer

blocks.title: The reporters' own past prints (store; excess reads where the print is on the lab floor)

source.sql: SELECT symbol, print_date, slot, runup, prev_react, eps_surprise, rev_surprise, react, react_fx, ah_read, ah_to_close, hold_fx_7d, hold_fx_28d, drift_fx_28d FROM history ORDER BY symbol, print_date DESC

blocks.text: The judgment's shortlist and positioning names in reading order, every column group.

blocks.title: Shortlist and positioning names

source.sql: SELECT n.symbol, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.next_kind, n.next_date, n.earn_date, n.earn_slot, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.entry_low, n.entry_high, n.kill_px, n.b28d_q20, n.b28d_q80, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM names n WHERE TRUE ORDER BY n.mcap_b DESC LIMIT 400

blocks.title: Sessions with catalysts: counts, the largest prints, Book prints, other events

source.sql: SELECT date, dow, week, n_earnings, n_ex_dividend, n_ipo_lockup, largest_earnings, book_earnings, other FROM days ORDER BY date

blocks.title: Dated OUTSIDE catalysts (catalyst_calendar.json): status and source on every row

source.sql: SELECT date, dow, week, kind, symbol, detail, status, read, source FROM events WHERE kind NOT IN ('earnings', 'ex_dividend', 'ipo_lockup') ORDER BY date

blocks.title: Printing this week, not yet out, $2B+: in print order

source.sql: SELECT n.symbol, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.earn_date, n.earn_slot, n.setup_cell, n.setup_mean, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.entry_low, n.entry_high, n.kill_px, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM names n WHERE n.earn_week = 'W0' AND (n.phase IS NULL OR n.phase <> 'post') AND n.mcap_b >= 2 ORDER BY n.earn_date, n.earn_slot, n.mcap_b DESC LIMIT 250

screens.label: Sold into, last print down
screens.explain: The earnings playbook's best pre-print set-up: sold into the print after a down print (second best: sold into after an up print). Then check revisions are not in the top quintile (priced) and street upside is wide; enter as a limit in the buy-in-red band.

screens.label: Cheap to own history, estimates rising
screens.explain: Forward P/E 10%+ under the name's own median with the next-FY EPS estimate rising over 3 months: value into the print.

screens.label: Book prints
screens.explain: Held lines printing this week, in print order: the hold vs DERISK read is on the Tonight tab (for tonight) and Week plays.

blocks.title: Printed this week (reaction known), $2B+: reaction vs the tape ascending

source.sql: SELECT n.symbol, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.earn_date, n.earn_slot, n.react_fx, n.mix_cell, n.mix_mean, n.big_cell, n.big_mean, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM names n WHERE n.phase = 'post' AND n.mcap_b >= 2 ORDER BY n.react_fx NULLS LAST LIMIT 120

screens.label: Sold 5%+, beat
screens.explain: Beat and still sold 5%+ vs the market: the recovery candidates; the big_cell column has that cell's drift.

blocks.title: Printing next week, $3B+: in print order

source.sql: SELECT n.symbol, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.earn_date, n.earn_slot, n.setup_cell, n.setup_mean, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.entry_low, n.entry_high, n.kill_px, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM names n WHERE n.earn_week = 'W1' AND n.mcap_b >= 3 ORDER BY n.earn_date, n.earn_slot, n.mcap_b DESC LIMIT 400

screens.label: Set-up cell positive
screens.explain: Names whose current set-up cell (run-up x previous reaction) held through better than zero on past prints.

screens.label: Book prints
screens.explain: Held lines printing next week.

blocks.title: Printing in weeks 3-6, alpha 28d decile 8+, $3B+: in print order (names to build into a later print)

source.sql: SELECT n.symbol, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.next_kind, n.next_date, n.earn_date, n.earn_slot, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.entry_low, n.entry_high, n.kill_px, n.b28d_q20, n.b28d_q80, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM names n WHERE n.earn_week IN ('W2', 'W3', 'W4', 'W5', 'W6') AND n.dec_28d >= 8 AND n.mcap_b >= 3 ORDER BY n.earn_date, n.dec_28d DESC LIMIT 200

blocks.title: Ex-dividend inside the horizon, $2B+: yield descending

source.sql: SELECT e.date AS ex_date, e.detail AS dividend, n.symbol, n.div_yield, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.next_kind, n.earn_date, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM events e JOIN names n USING (symbol) WHERE e.kind = 'ex_dividend' AND n.mcap_b >= 2 ORDER BY n.div_yield DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 80

blocks.title: IPO lockups inside the horizon (offer date + 180 days, estimated)

source.sql: SELECT e.date AS lockup_date, e.detail AS lockup, n.symbol, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.next_kind, n.earn_date, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM events e JOIN names n USING (symbol) WHERE e.kind = 'ipo_lockup' ORDER BY e.date LIMIT 60

blocks.title: Names an OUTSIDE catalyst row points at

source.sql: SELECT e.date AS event_date, e.kind AS event_kind, e.detail AS event, n.symbol, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.next_kind, n.earn_date, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM events e JOIN names n USING (symbol) WHERE e.kind NOT IN ('earnings', 'ex_dividend', 'ipo_lockup') ORDER BY e.date LIMIT 60

blocks.title: On no pack list, alpha 28d decile 9+, last print beat, $3B+: pred_28d descending

source.sql: SELECT n.symbol, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.next_kind, n.next_date, n.earn_date, n.earn_slot, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.entry_low, n.entry_high, n.kill_px, n.b28d_q20, n.b28d_q80, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM names n WHERE n.pack_lists IS NULL AND n.dec_28d >= 9 AND n.last_surprise > 0 AND n.mcap_b >= 3 ORDER BY n.pred_28d DESC LIMIT 80

screens.label: Cheap vs industry
screens.explain: Forward P/E 20%+ under the industry median among the overlooked names.

blocks.title: Thin coverage (8 analysts or fewer), alpha 28d decile 9+, $2B+: pred_28d descending

source.sql: SELECT n.symbol, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.next_kind, n.next_date, n.earn_date, n.earn_slot, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.entry_low, n.entry_high, n.kill_px, n.b28d_q20, n.b28d_q80, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM names n WHERE TRY_CAST(n.analysts AS DOUBLE) <= 8 AND n.dec_28d >= 9 AND n.mcap_b >= 2 ORDER BY n.pred_28d DESC LIMIT 60

blocks.title: Strongest 28-day read, decile 10 with 56d decile 8+, $5B+: pred_28d descending

source.sql: SELECT n.symbol, n.ind, n.mcap_b, n.close, n.day, n.m1, n.rsi, n.rng, n.vs50, n.tape_state, n.next_kind, n.next_date, n.earn_date, n.earn_slot, n.bounce_low, n.bounce_high, n.bounce_kill, n.entry_low, n.entry_high, n.kill_px, n.b28d_q20, n.b28d_q80, n.last_surprise, n.rev_surprise, n.surprise_mix, n.react_last, n.react_abs_mean, n.pe_nfy, n.pe_nfy_vs_ind, n.pe_nfy_vs_own, n.fcf_margin, n.nd_ebitda, n.pt_up, n.eps_rev_3m, n.pt_drift_3m, n.dec_7d, n.dec_28d, n.pred_28d, n.lenses, n.analysts, n.pack_lists, n.book_usd FROM names n WHERE n.dec_28d >= 10 AND n.dec_56d >= 8 AND n.mcap_b >= 5 ORDER BY n.pred_28d DESC LIMIT 80

blocks.title: Weakest 28-day read (decile 1), $5B+: what the regime is selling

guide.intro: What each tab answers, how to work it, and the one-click screens. Tables are data; Course / Reason and the Plan tab are judgment. Nothing is a score: every column is its own order, and counts of arrows count measured cells.

rows: The day's judgment: top plays, the shortlist, positioning for 4-5 weeks, OUTSIDE catalysts.
Every name whose print reaction lands on the next session: measured pointers up / down per horizon, the overnight tail, levels.

Read a row left to right; green = measured up, red = measured down, a bare number = no clear direction.

Empty until the print is in the day file; read it at the cash close.
The backtest behind every arrow (cells), every arrow per name, and the reporters' own past prints.
Arrows only; check n, both halves and hit_lift.

The ids the Plan tab names.

sections.title: Tonight: pre-print entry, step by step
rows: The Session base table is what an average print did: the reaction is close to a coin flip with a wide tail both ways. A pointer only shifts those odds; it never removes the tail.
Start with Hold 28d leans up or 7d leans up. The reaction column (rx) rarely has arrows: fields known before a print have barely called the reaction session itself; they have called the hold-through.
Read h28_fam_up: up pointers from one family (Tape: run-up, month, RSI, 50-day) are one bet; from three families, three bets.
Any ▼ in Estimates or History is a reason to wait for the print and buy the reaction instead.

tail_starter_usd is what a $5,000 starter took overnight in the set-up cell's bad case (10th percentile). If that is more than you accept, wait: the bounce band after the print is the alternative entry.
dec_7d_fx with state_7d (WEAK / FAILING = context only); peer_rx = how this industry's prints are being paid this season; valuation to the industry and to its own history.

Earnings playbook: a limit between the alpha 7d q20 and the top of the bounce band (not the band middle), a kill on a close, size from the Daily's event budget; decide at the cash close, not after hours.

A held line with ▼ on the hold horizons and a wide tail: DERISK into the print to the dollars you accept (rx_tail_usd on Week plays). Price-only damage after the print is held (deterioration playbook).

sections.title: After the print: digest
items: Read `rev_posted` before the mix: false means the revenue actual is not in the scan yet, so B/M or M/M can be an artefact.

The digest's arrows say which way prints with this surprise, mix, after-hours read or reaction went next (rx reaction, ac reaction close vs after hours, d28 drift); the week-plays cells beside them are the set-up x reaction and after-hours quintile cells.
On an AMC night decide at the cash close: an ac arrow up means such after-hours reads closed better than they printed.
A deep sell-off with no d28 arrow down is a recovery candidate for the bounce band; the kill re-arms at the reaction session's low.

sections.title: How a pointer is measured
items: Each pointer is a field known at the time, cut into quintiles on the signal lab's past prints (store features at each print's pre-print file); slot and mix use their categories.
lift = the cell's mean minus every other print's mean on the same measure; lift_t = Welch t (prints treated as independent: optimistic).

▲ / ▼ needs |lift_t| at or above t_min (2.0) on at least min_n (40) prints, the same sign in both halves of the sample and the hit rate moving the same way (recipe config/generic_utils/print_night.json).
About 400 cells are tested: expect a few arrows by chance. Middle-quintile arrows often mirror a U-shape (the ends did better); end-quintile arrows that agree across families carry more weight.
The sample is one market regime (spring to autumn 2026); hold-through cells need 28 days of labels, so the newest prints are not in them yet.

rows: The cell's mean of its measure over its prints (pp); on the base table, every past print's.
Median of the measure over every past print (pp).
Share of the cell's prints (or of every print) with a positive value of the measure.
10th / 90th percentile of the measure over the cell's prints: the bad and the good case.
Pointer family: Tape, History, Estimates, Street, Value, Model, Peers before the print; Print, Session after it.
What the pointer or measure is, in words.
The name's value of that pointer now (category text for slot and mix).
pre = a pointer known before the print; post = a field of the print itself.
